speaker: ARIN
text: I remember now. I ignored the warning.

speaker: MIRA
text: Arin! Abort! I'll get you out of here!

speaker: ARIN
text: The voice... Mira? You've been guiding me all this time?

speaker: MIRA
text: I'm the memory you buried. You couldn't face what happened when the Core collapsed.

speaker: ARIN
text: You stayed behind to save me.

speaker: MIRA
text: You remember now. Finish what we couldn't.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: 1. Disable the signal resonator. 2. Vent the stored energy. 3. Isolate the core.
